hazards.control: Test the stack to the program pressures; bleed and verify zero before breaking any connection.
Monitors at the floor and the bell nipple; escape sets staged.

name: Adapter, bell nipple, and studs
function: The crossover flange to the tubing head, the bell nipple on top that returns fluid to the flowline, and the stud sets between every flange.

tabs.overview: Adapter matched to the tubing head flange; bell nipple sized to the pipe and the mud return rate.
tabs.safety: Studs made up to torque; the bell nipple is the H2S monitoring point.
tabs.evidence: API Spec 16A (S48), API Std 53 (S49), API RP 16ST (S53), field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
